hook: The chain that ends in disaster
aciklama:
Plane crashes almost never have a single cause - they are a chain of small failures. Here is how that chain forms, and why flying is still the safest way to travel.

#shorts #aviation #engineering #science #safety

sahneler.metin: A plane crash is almost never one thing going wrong.
It is a chain of small failures that line up perfectly.
A tiny sensor freezes, and the computer gets the wrong airspeed.
The pilots, confused and exhausted, trust the wrong reading.
Add bad weather and a rushed decision, and the chain is complete.
Break any single link, and the disaster never happens.
That is why every crash is studied down to the last second.
Each one makes the next flight safer than the last.
Today you are more likely to be hurt driving to the airport.
